crossRefs.note: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.
Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my…
I cried to you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will…
For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we…
At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the…
Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in…
The dead don’t praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;

translations.web: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.
translations.bsb: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
translations.kjv: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
translations.asv: Unless Jehovah had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.
